metadata.title: TisaneOnprem
metadata.description: Module for on premise installtion of Tisane

findings.title: Network retrieval combined with code execution
findings.description: The same file contains both a network retrieval pattern and a dynamic execution pattern. This combination merits review and is not by itself proof of malicious intent.

evidence.snippet: $response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $uri -Method POST -Headers $headers -ContentType 'application/json' -Body '{"language": "en", "content": "this is a test sentence to test the testing of tisane", "settings": {"parses":true,"debug":true}}' -TimeoutSec $timeout  …  Start-Process -FilePath $DOWNLOAD_FOLDER/dotnetinstaller.exe -ArgumentList "/q","/norestart" -Wait

findings.title: Separate username and password parameters are declared
findings.description: Function 'Download-TisaneFromFTP' has both Username and Password parameters. Either set the type of the Password parameter to SecureString or replace the Username and Password parameters with a Credential parameter of type PSCredential. If using a Credential parameter in PowerShell 4.0 or earlier, please define a credential transformation attribute after the PSCredential type attribute.
